title: Vaerion project configuration (vaerion.yaml) — schema 0.1
description: The human-authored head of the source-of-truth chain (ADR-0007): vaerion.yaml -> vaerion.lock -> spec/. Unknown keys are rejected at load time (drift guard, E1201); the resolved configuration is fingerprinted with blake3 over its canonical JSON into every run header. Zero telemetry is structural: telemetry.enabled may only be false (constitution P10/D-K). Permissions are cumulative ceilings — grants never widen beyond them. Manifests use the VaerYaml strict subset: anchors, aliases, multi-document streams, tags, and complex mapping keys are banned.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration schema version; must equal a supported version.

name.description: Project name; lowercase kebab identifier used in policy ids and bundles.

permissions.description: Cumulative permission ceilings. Omitted sections deny everything of that kind by default (fail-closed); declared ceilings still evaluate through the broker, which may deny or prompt.

allowHosts.description: Hosts (host or host:port) that network capabilities may target. Network access is a broker-mediated capability, never ambient (E1402).

allowCommands.description: Command ceilings (glob-ish patterns) that exec capabilities may request; grants only narrow these.

research.description: Declared research capabilities (constitution D-O). Sources are declared before use; undeclared network is forbidden.

name.description: Capability name; referenced by evidence records and broker policy.

sources.description: Declared sources. v0.1 admits local sources only — undeclared network access is forbidden by law (E1402).

kind.description: Source kind; local only in v0.1.

fencing.description: Fencing applied to content from this capability's sources; untrusted content never enters trusted channels (E1401).

maxItems.description: Optional bound on items ingested per index/update cycle.

policy.description: Declared broker policy rules (MS-2 policy files). Rules are evaluated first-match-wins; an unmatched request is denied fail-closed (E1301). Every rule must state its rationale — declared authority explains itself.

scope.description: Scope pattern (see capability scope matcher: '*', prefix/**, prefix/*).

gateLabel.description: Human-visible gate label for prompt rules.

gateway.description: Model Gateway declaration (MS-3). Enabled providers declare their reachable models as `provider/model` ceiling scopes; disabled providers grant nothing (fail-closed at the ceiling layer). Budgets are per-run ceilings in tokens and integer micro-USD; exceeded budgets stop the run loudly (E1703), never silently.

providers.description: Known provider keys only: anthropic, openai, ollama, mockbrain. The offline virtual provider mockbrain (ADR-0012) is declared like any provider — its ceiling scopes make it reachable through the broker; declaring none grants nothing.

models.description: Model ids reachable under this provider; each becomes a `provider/model` scope in the permission ceiling.

microUsdPerRun.description: Per-run ceiling in integer micro-USD (never floats; R-MG3).

secrets.description: Secret NAMES with scoped grants (ADR-0013). Values are resolved exclusively at call time from the OS keychain (service `vae`) or environment indirection; a value never enters configuration, journal, receipt, or log. Reads are broker-mediated `secret.read` decisions. Grant patterns are matched against principal ids with the capability scope matcher.

grant.description: Non-empty list of principal-id patterns granted this secret (e.g. "gateway:*"); humans may always read locally.

agents.description: Agent loop declaration (MS-4). The supervisor ceiling bounds journaled agent steps per run; exceeded ceilings stop the run loudly (E1804). The planner model is invoked through the gateway single gate and its ceiling still applies.

maxSteps.description: Ceiling on journaled agent steps per run (default 24).

plannerModel.description: Canonical provider/model-id used by the LLM planner through the gateway single gate.

tools.description: Declared tools (MS-4). Only declared names can be authorized for tool.exec decisions; undeclared tools are refused fail-closed (E1801). Grants still require explicit broker policy rules — declaring a tool grants nothing by itself.

name.description: Tool name; lowercase identifier matched exactly at invocation time.

scope.description: Broker scope for the tool.exec decision; defaults to the tool name.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does.

telemetry.description: Zero telemetry is structural law: no phone-home, diagnostics stay on the machine.

enabled.description: May only be false. Any other value is a configuration error (E1202).
